package.name: hexa_posture_cpp
package.description: C++ port of hexa_posture: the posture controller node and its pure animation stack. The library (pose composition, animations, and the support- signal / gating helpers) links without rclcpp and is unit-testable standalone; only the posture_node executable touches ROS. Built side-by-side with the Python hexa_posture until the cutover — hexa_bringup still launches the Python node, and hexa_teleop still reads the Python config helper.
